sources.quote: Windows 11 KB5132061 & KB5131087 cumulative updates released
Microsoft has released the Patch Tuesday Windows 11 and cumulative updates for versions 26H2/25H2/24H2 and 23H2 to fix security vulnerabilities and bugs, and add new features.
With the November Patch Tuesday rollout, you can finally customize your right-click menu in Windows 11.

claims.statement: Microsoft released its November Patch Tuesday cumulative updates for Windows 11.

sources.quote: New Windows 11 update fixes File Explorer menu mess – and patches an exploited flaw

claims.statement: The update adds a customizable File Explorer right-click menu and fixes 1,094 security flaws, including an exploited one.

analysis.headline: Microsoft releases November Patch Tuesday update for Windows 11
analysis.summary: Microsoft released its November Patch Tuesday cumulative updates for Windows 11, fixing security vulnerabilities including an exploited flaw, and adding a customizable File Explorer right-click menu.
